6. Prove the first clock is jointly BorelThe target extended time is generated by closed lower intervals. The preimage of Iic(∞) is the whole space. For finite t, the crossing event identifies the preimage as {e≤Λ_z(t)}, a Borel inequality between the threshold coordinate and the jointly Borel cumulative hazard.
